meta.title: Football Player Guessing Game — 321guess
meta.description: Free football player guessing game. Two club badges or a flag + a badge appear — name a player who played for both. Play with a friend, no login, no download.

home.tagline: Name a player who played for both teams — local co-op, browser-based, no signup.
home.intro: 321guess is a free football player guessing game for fans. You're shown two club badges, or a flag plus a club badge, and the goal is to name a player who played for both teams. Questions are drawn from a broad pool covering the Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Turkish Süper Lig, and more — from world giants like Barcelona, Real Madrid and Manchester United to lesser-known clubs. No registration, no downloads — just open a browser and play with a friend. If you'd rather compete solo, the Daily Challenge mode lets you race players worldwide on 5 questions that change every day, with just a username — no account required.
howToSteps: Pick a mode: Club × Club or Country × Club.
Choose a difficulty and the leagues you want included.
When the 3-2-1 countdown ends, name a player who played for both teams.

faq.a: Yes, completely free. No signup, no app install — it runs in the browser.
It's designed for two or more people around one screen. One reads the prompt, others race to name a player who played for both teams. Solo play works too.

faq.q: Which leagues and clubs are included?
faq.a: Turkish Süper Lig, Premier League, LaLiga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1 and more. You can toggle any league on or off in the setup screen.
You see a flag and a club badge. You need to name a player of that nationality who played for that club.
Player data comes from Wikidata and is refreshed regularly. Hit 'Show Answers' at the end of a round to see the valid players.
An online mode with 5 questions that change daily, the same for everyone. Type as many correct players as you can in 3 minutes and compete on the leaderboard.

faq.q: Do I need an account to play online mode?
faq.a: No. No email or password — just pick a username and start playing.
Most correct players found ranks first; ties go to whoever finished faster. There's also a separate all-time leaderboard for total players found.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: 321guess is a free football player guessing game. This page explains what little data the website and mobile app collect and why.

sections.heading: No account, no personal information
sections.body: 321guess never asks for your name, email address, or password. Local (offline) play doesn't send anything to our servers at all.

sections.heading: Daily Challenge (online mode)
sections.body: If you choose to play the Daily Challenge, your browser or app generates a random identifier and stores it on your device together with the username you pick. That identifier and username are sent to our server to track your daily score, streak, and leaderboard position. There is no way for us to link this identifier to your real identity.

sections.heading: Push notifications (mobile app)
sections.body: The 321guess mobile app can ask permission to send push notifications. If you allow it, your device registers a push token with our server, used only to send one daily notification announcing that a new Daily Challenge is ready. We don't use push tokens for anything else, and you can disable notifications at any time in your device's system settings.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: We use Google Analytics to understand overall traffic (e.g. which pages are visited, roughly how many people play). This tool does not receive your username, push token, or which players you guessed.

sections.heading: Data retention and deletion
sections.body: Daily Challenge scores and streaks are kept to power the leaderboard. You can stop playing online mode at any time. To have your username and all associated data deleted, email us at the address below with your username — we'll delete it permanently.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
sections.body: 321guess does not knowingly collect data from children under 13.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about this policy, or data-deletion requests, can be sent to munurcoskun@gmail.com.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using 321guess, you agree to the terms below. We've tried to keep them short and readable — reach out via the contact section if you have questions.

sections.heading: What the service is
sections.body: 321guess is a free football player guessing game. No account is required and there are no in-app purchases. The Daily Challenge (online mode) is optional and requires picking a username.

sections.heading: Usernames and conduct
sections.body: The username you pick for the Daily Challenge passes through a profanity filter and appears on a public leaderboard. We may change or remove usernames that are inappropriate, harassing, or impersonate someone else, without prior notice.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: Club names, logos, and flags shown in the game belong to their respective clubs/federations and are shown only for identification/informational purposes under fair use. 321guess is not affiliated with or endorsed by these clubs.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
sections.body: 321guess is provided "as is". We don't guarantee the underlying data (e.g. player-club history) is always 100% accurate or current, and we don't guarantee uninterrupted availability.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect or incidental damages arising from your use of 321guess.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Meaningful changes will update the "last updated" date on this page.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Turkey.
